name: Kyuutarou
source:
Kyuutarou is [url=/c38028]Fuuka[/url]'s favorite plush. Fuuka's father bought it in a foreign country during one of his business trips because he thought it was cute. According to him, this plush toy reflects the Cupid of the culture of the country in which he bought it, and this cupid would have the power to make people happy by fulfilling their wishes.

"Make a contract with me and I'll let you use hypnotism♪"
